title: Rust DAO TX runtime wiring: drive send_dao from dao_tx_timing state via runtime_poll actions
description: Follow-up from b7z9.16.1 (state machine landed, commit 870577f9db + 2358ce17de): the runtime_poll action loop (rust/lichen-node/src/rpl_stack/runtime.rs RplRuntimeAction {Receive, TrickleTransmit, TrickleExpire}) has no DAO TX action. Add plumbing so a joined Leaf drives DaoTimingState (dao_tx_timing.rs): on_join at DODAG join, poll next_action in runtime_poll, on_due -> send_dao() (rpl_stack/transmit.rs) then on_sent/on_ack per outcome. Wiring must consume the dao_timing oracle (no constant duplication) and keep the state machine pure (monotonic now_ms only). Tests: fake-clock runtime poll asserting initial 0-2s, 4/8/16 retries, 900s refresh. Blocked on: this host's lichen-node lib tests are blocked by oscore-fork 0.1.2/0.1.3 drift (env-only; heft or main-checkout can run them).
close_reason: Duplicate of work already landed: the DAO TX runtime wiring this bead requests is the SAME wiring I landed in 39fe4351d1 (round-set with lagn/b7z9.16.1) and the lagn slice (de0a5a970e). Comparison: (1) 'on_join at DODAG join' — DaoTxScheduler::schedule_initial is invoked from dao_tx_advance on the join transition (rpl_stack/mod.rs dao_tx_advance); (2) 'poll next_action in runtime_poll' — RplStack::runtime_poll checks dao_tx_advance and returns RplRuntimeAction::DaoTransmit when Due (rpl_stack/runtime.rs); (3) 'on_due -> send_dao()' — the executor sees DaoTransmit and drives send_dao; (4) 'on_sent' — complete_dao_transmit clears pending and schedules maintenance (runtime.rs complete_dao_transmit); (5) retry ladder — scheduler on_dao_failed walks 4/8/16s with Exhausted per R-09-019; (6) refresh — on_dao_sent reschedules at half-lifetime. The 'fake-clock asserting initial 0-2s, 4/8/16 retries, 900s refresh' tests are exactly the dao_tx_sched unit tests + the RplStack dao_tx integration test, all green (337/337). The only deltas vs this bead's text: the state machine lives on RplStack (dao_tx_sched.rs) rather than dao_timing.rs (which remains the constants oracle — no duplication), and the fork drift blocker was resolved (4a8ad156e0 oscore API alignment). Duplicate of landed work; closing.
